title: SELECTEDVALUE needs no filter when the column has a single value

source.quote: An equivalent expression for SELECTEDVALUE(<columnName>, <alternateResult>) is IF(HASONEVALUE(<columnName>), VALUES(<columnName>), <alternateResult>) .
source.supports: SELECTEDVALUE returns the value when the column has one visible value, else the alternate

source.quote: HASONEVALUE corresponds to the following code: COUNTROWS ( VALUES ( <ColumnName> ) ) = 1

derivation: Param has one row, so Param[Value] has one visible value without any filter: HASONEVALUE is TRUE and the value 1000 is returned.
